positive_requirement: Exact authority designates this PRE-V3 materializer for the exact fact class/domain/claim/use/time grain.
prohibited_substitutes: world-root ownership; downstream need; V3 request; branch name
downstream_note: Without this ref no positive fact may be emitted.

positive_requirement: Authorizes the exact objective position/role meaning asserted.
prohibited_substitutes: label; code; geometry; demographic category; historical ontology name
downstream_note: Keeps semantic ownership domain-scoped.

positive_requirement: Exact immutable objective entity/actor identity at the asserted grain.
prohibited_substitutes: V3 subject/person materialization receipt; name string; demographic bucket
downstream_note: Actor-indexing does not imply PRE-V3 person ownership.

positive_requirement: Exact immutable identity of the position/role relation being asserted.
prohibited_substitutes: free text; coordinate; cluster; inferred trait
downstream_note: This is the position identity, not the resulting fact identity.

positive_requirement: Exact source universe supplying the assertion/evidence.
prohibited_substitutes: latest source; implicit corpus; unrelated source
downstream_note: Must agree with release and evidence.

positive_requirement: Exact immutable release/snapshot used by the claim.
prohibited_substitutes: latest; default; wall-clock selection
downstream_note: Release change creates a different fact determinant.

positive_requirement: Exact claim/proposition supporting the objective position assertion.
prohibited_substitutes: citation alone; general theory; downstream operation requirement
downstream_note: Claim identity must be independently resolvable.

positive_requirement: Competent authority for use of the exact source claim at this grain.
prohibited_substitutes: mere source presence; repository inclusion
downstream_note: Citation is not permission or semantic authority.

positive_requirement: Exact immutable evidence directly supporting the asserted entity-position proposition.
prohibited_substitutes: correlation/fit alone; favorable target result; labels; geometry
downstream_note: Evidence set participates in fact identity/replay.

positive_requirement: Required when position/role identity depends on claim-bounded role adjudication; must bind same actor grain/claim/use/scope/time/evidence.
prohibited_substitutes: prior PRA for another claim; source semantics alone; weight role
downstream_note: OBL005 is claim-bounded and not a universal runtime classifier.

positive_requirement: Required if D03-IN-010 is omitted; proves role adjudication is inapplicable because another competent constitutive source/rule owns the position semantics.
prohibited_substitutes: silent omission; worker assertion
downstream_note: Exactly one lawful role-authority path must be explicit.

positive_requirement: Required when role adjudication is constitutive of a target claim; proves pre-result freeze or result-independence.
prohibited_substitutes: post-hoc favorable result; worker statement
downstream_note: Carries OBL005 result-independence ceiling.

positive_requirement: Authorizes the rule for deciding applicability at entity/context/time grain.
prohibited_substitutes: similarity; demographic proxy; downstream convenience
downstream_note: Does not itself prove applicability.

positive_requirement: Positive exact receipt that the asserted position applies to this entity/context/time.
prohibited_substitutes: membership guess; nearest match; fuzzy resolution
downstream_note: Must agree with identity/source/time refs.

positive_requirement: Authorizes exact downstream uses of the fact.
prohibited_substitutes: consumer request; inherited broad permission
downstream_note: Permission cannot widen source or semantic-owner ceilings.

positive_requirement: Canonical bounded set of permitted objective uses, subset of all upstream ceilings.
prohibited_substitutes: wildcard; implicit all uses; person-state use
downstream_note: M2/Field Forge may consume only an allowed use.

positive_requirement: Exact negative/refusal ceiling preserving what the evidence does not prove.
prohibited_substitutes: missing-as-false; unresolved-as-negative; silent completion
downstream_note: Travels with the positive fact as a semantic ceiling.

positive_requirement: Authorizes semantics of the exact valid-time/as-of basis.
prohibited_substitutes: wall clock; bare timestamp; V3 runtime cursor
downstream_note: Objective validity is upstream of V3.

positive_requirement: Typed concrete valid-time/interval/as-of basis for the assertion.
prohibited_substitutes: untyped hash; latest/default; study-world designator
downstream_note: Must be covered by valid_time_authority_ref.

positive_requirement: Authorizes the currentness decision rule for this assertion.
prohibited_substitutes: immutability alone; publication alone; world-root existence
downstream_note: Fact currentness remains distinct from world-root currentness.

positive_requirement: Typed receipt covering the assertion at the claimed as-of/interval.
prohibited_substitutes: M5/V3 cursor used retroactively; silence since old event
downstream_note: Historical/noncurrent state must remain typed.

positive_requirement: Exact immutable provenance chain to source/claim/authority/evidence.
prohibited_substitutes: human-readable citation alone; mutable URL
downstream_note: Must be replay-discoverable.

positive_requirement: Canonical exact determinants required to support/invalidate this fact.
prohibited_substitutes: implicit dependencies; hidden defaults
downstream_note: Reverse dependency discovery required for bounded invalidation.

positive_requirement: Authorizes deterministic canonicalization/hash/replay procedure.
prohibited_substitutes: nondeterministic latest lookup; wall clock
downstream_note: Same canonical tuple must reproduce same fact identity.

positive_requirement: Exact immutable predecessor when this fact is a successor version/currentness reconstruction.
prohibited_substitutes: in-place mutation; global actor reset
downstream_note: Null for first materialization; historical predecessor remains immutable.

positive_requirement: Exact immutable implementation/hash identity of the materializer executing this contract, covered by producer authority.
prohibited_substitutes: branch name; mutable latest code; undocumented helper
downstream_note: Required for deterministic replay and OBL005-compatible implementation identity.
